Messages.Author: talonz
Messages.Body: Can an ally with bestow vigor play a for card that has a blood cost? Search of the old newsgroup turned up nothing on this.

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
> talonz wrote:
> Can an ally with bestow vigor play a for card that has a blood cost? Search of the old newsgroup turned up nothing on this.
>
Yes, and the answer is in the Rulebook:
>
> Non-existant user wrote:
> Some allies have the ability to play certain cards "as a vampire." In these cases, the ally is treated as a vampire for all effects generated by the play of the card, including duration effects (like "for the remainder of combat"). The ally's life represents his blood (to pay costs, for example). Any blood he gains or loses as a vampire equates to a gain or loss of life for the ally. For purposes of that card, the ally has a capacity of 1 by default (for use if the card requires an older vampire or a vampire of a given capacity). If the ally gains life in excess of his capacity, it doesn't drain off, and if the effect inflicts aggravated damage on the ally, he burns life as normal. However, if the effect would send the ally to torpor, then he is burned instead. The ally is treated as a vampire only for the effect generated from playing the card. In particular, the ally is not treated as a vampire for effects the card has from being in play (like "the vampire with this card" effects).
>
> Name: Bestow Vigor
> [LotN:R]
> Cardtype: Action
> Cost: 1 blood
> Discipline: Fortitude
> +1 stealth action.
> [for] Play on a vampire you control and untap this acting vampire. The minion with this card may play combat cards that require Fortitude [for] as a vampire with basic Fortitude. Burn this card at the end of your next turn.
> [FOR] As above, but play on an ally you control.
>

Messages.Author: Miasmat
Messages.Body:
What happens when my ally with Bestow Vigor plays Day Operation?

> Day Operation
> Only usable as the action is announced. Vampires cannot block this action. The acting vampire goes to torpor after resolving the action.
>
Nothing, since he's not an "acting vampire"?

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> Miasmat wrote:
> What happens when my ally with Bestow Vigor plays Day Operation?
>
> > Day Operation
> > Only usable as the action is announced. Vampires cannot block this action. The acting vampire goes to torpor after resolving the action.
> >
> Nothing, since he's not an "acting vampire"?
>
Day Operation isn't a combat card. You can't play it with Bestow Vigor.

Messages.Author: talonz
Messages.Body: Thanks pascal, clearly I was looking in the wrong place in the rulebook.

Messages.Body:

> > >

> Day Operation isn't a combat card. You can't play it with Bestow Vigor.

However, a Bima who plays a Day Operation will be sent to torpor. Allies who are sent to torpor burn instead.

(If the Bima played Daring the Dawn, it'd take agg damage - which, as an ally, it wouldn't handle any differently from normal damage. Though that would likely mean it burned due to lack of life.)
